source_note: Reconstructed 2026-09-18 by Fable 5.1 from ~200 web-search result sets (titles, URLs, indexed snippets) of caltenantlaw.com store/category/product pages and the /all-services/ catalog. Direct fetches of caltenantlaw.com, caltenantlaw.company.site (Ecwid Instant Site), web.archive.org and other mirrors are blocked by the egress proxy, so NOTHING here was read from a live page; every price is 'as indexed' with unknown crawl date, and every item is verified:false. Ecwid store id was not discoverable. Product URL pattern: /store/<SKU>-<Title>-p<productId>; categories -c<categoryId>; the same product is re-listed under several category paths (default/, game-board/, legal-kits/, judgment/, appeal/, free-resources/...). Prices from earlier crawls that differ are recorded in price_history. Phase labels come from docs/game-board/nodes.json phases[].label; stage_node_ids from nodes[].id.

categories.label: Schedule a Consultation
categories.description: Entry point: initial and follow-up attorney consultations (30 min, phone or Microsoft Teams) plus short evaluation products. Reached from the Initial / Follow-up Consultation forms.

categories.label: Talk to an attorney
categories.description: Every paid path starts with a licensed California tenant attorney on the phone. Grouped here by CTL OS; the store lists these as separate categories.

categories.label: Legal Hotline (existing clients)
categories.description: Not an Ecwid product: per-minute phone line run on VoiceStamps Technologies; $60 card deposit per 10-minute block, unused minutes refunded.

categories.label: Free and do-it-yourself
categories.description: What costs nothing, and what you can do yourself with the forms and the instructions. Grouped here by CTL OS; the store lists these as separate categories.

categories.label: Legal Kits
categories.description: Self-help PDF e-books: forms, step-by-step instructions, strategy, what to expect in court. Delivered as an Adobe PDF download page after payment.

categories.label: Free Resources
categories.description: $0 downloads: Game Board PDF, Habitability Worksheet, Prejudgment Claim form, UD Form Interrogatories forms, small-claims complaint, temporary relocation agreement.

categories.label: Game Board Services
categories.description: The same paid services re-listed by eviction stage ('legal services organized by the Eviction Game Board - find the right service for each step of the California unlawful detainer process'). Ecwid category c34591035 'Unlawful Detainer Game Board'.

categories.label: Letters to the Landlord
categories.description: Pre-litigation demand / negotiation letters drafted by the lawyer (SKU 110-111). Store files them under Schedule a Consultation / Changes to Prepared Paperwork paths.

categories.label: Motion to Quash
categories.description: 'Challenge defective service or a defective summons before filing your Answer.' Ranges from the initial motion to appellate review (writ of mandate) and removal to federal court. Ecwid c29490094.

categories.label: Default
categories.description: 'All aspects of a default, where you have officially lost the case and want to un-lose it': ex parte stay to stop the lockout plus motion for relief from default (your fault) or motion to vacate (clerk's fault).

categories.label: Discovery
categories.description: Both sides can demand documents and answers. In an eviction discovery closes five days before trial. Grouped here by CTL OS; the store lists ours and theirs as separate categories.

categories.label: Discovery - by Us
categories.description: 'Your attempt to get information from which to prepare your case for trial': requests for admission, form/special interrogatories, requests for production, meet-and-confer, motions to compel. Ecwid c29490097.

categories.label: Discovery - by Them / Their Discovery to You
categories.description: 'The landlord's attempts to get information from you': responses, objections, opposition to their motion to compel, deposition preparation. Ecwid c3290605.

categories.label: Demurrer
categories.description: 'Challenge a defective unlawful detainer complaint before filing your Answer.' Demurrers and motions to strike the Complaint or Cross-complaint, replies, oppositions, meet-and-confer. Ecwid c29490099.

categories.label: Answer
categories.description: 'Preparing your Answer to the Complaint, and related paperwork.' Ecwid c29490100.

categories.label: Trial Preparation / Heading to Trial
categories.description: 'Get ready for trial with jury instructions and other papers you will need to file, help making your presentation effective, and other trial-related services.' Includes Motion for Summary Judgment and Court Appearance. Ecwid c3290609 / c2707015.

categories.label: Settling and Negotiation
categories.description: 'Your negotiation for a settlement, settlement terms, the agreement, and enforcement.' Ecwid c29490104.

categories.label: Judgment
categories.description: 'The judgment in a case, including document preparation and advice' - cost memorandum / attorney-fee motion after a win, motion for new trial after a loss.

categories.label: Appeal
categories.description: 'Appeal of the judgment if your default was improperly taken or the judgment was illegal or improper': appeal package, stays, record augmentation, briefs. Ecwid c3290636.

categories.label: Suing the Landlord
categories.description: 'Sue your California landlord for damages - security deposit, habitability, harassment, wrongful eviction. Tenant side only.' Small claims, cross-complaint in the eviction, or separate Superior Court suit. Ecwid c29490107 / 'Sue Your Landlord' c3692258.

categories.label: Extra Services
categories.description: Clerical / procedural add-ons: fax/e-filing and process-service arranging, Case Management Conference statement, correcting clerk mistakes.

categories.label: Changes to Prepared Paperwork
categories.description: 'Amendments where paperwork has already been properly prepared by the lawyer, but you want some changes made other than corrections of errors.' No SKU-level item indexed; likely billed via Supplemental Payments.

categories.label: Miscellaneous / Supplemental
categories.description: 'Supplemental payments, advance posting, and overtime payments. PLEASE DO NOT USE THIS OPTION UNLESS EXPRESSLY INSTRUCTED TO DO SO.' Top-ups for minimum-charge items and hourly overage at $330/hr.

categories.label: Judges Gone Wild
categories.description: Category name seen in store nav; contents not indexed (presumably writs / judicial-misconduct remedies).

categories.label: Legal Ethics
categories.description: Category name seen in store nav (URL slug 'legal-ethics-musical'); contents not indexed.

Nothing here invents a price, a SKU or a promise; unknown stays null and the UI renders 'to be confirmed'.
